correctness.rationale: Substitution yields the exact co-rotating real DDE and entire determinant F(λ;k). At k=0 two scalar factors are stable outside the double symmetry origin for every 0<β<π/2 by a homotopy with no possible nonzero imaginary root. For k>0 the second zero root moves left; the only nonzero imaginary roots are odd multiples of iπ, at k_j=(ω_j²−4β²)/(2β). Direct differentiation gives a simple pair and strictly positive crossing slope 4βA_j/(A_j²+4ω_j²). The right-half-plane bound |λ|²≤4β²+2βk excludes roots entering from infinity. Count starts zero and increases by exactly two per crossing. RFDE linearized orbital attraction/instability principles yield the claimed local conclusions. The included verifier checks algebra, derivatives and sample crossings, but is not a proof of the infinite spectrum.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 full paper presents the circular-orbit instability threshold as an open component of Hara’s long-standing conjecture. The new theorem supplies an exact sharp boundary for every positive rotation angle and a complete infinite sequence of subsequent spectral crossings, quantitatively determining unstable-manifold dimension. This answers a natural stability question about the original system rather than a modified one, without equating the linear threshold with global attractor selection.
